check_cuda_coredump_enabled: check if CUDA coredump is enabled by calling is_enabled() and return a boolean flag
get_cuda_coredump_directory: get the CUDA coredump output directory path by calling get_dump_dir()
inject_cuda_coredump_env_vars: inject CUDA coredump environment variables into the current process for GPU exception coredump generation
cleanup_cuda_coredump_files: cleanup stale CUDA coredump files from the dump directory by calling cleanup_dump_dir()
report_cuda_coredump_detections: report any detected CUDA coredump files with sizes and cuda-gdb analysis instructions after a test failure
